text:
cleo_partnerships: Quick sync: PartnerCloud asked for a synchronized marketplace publish + joint blog. Can we sketch the end-to-end checklist here?

omar_marketing: High level timeline request from PartnerCloud: soft-launch May 10, broad announce May 12. They want a staged marketplace tile + co-authored blog on announce date.

rachel_csm: Onboarding ask: we need a sandbox tenant pre-provisioned and a runbook for CSMs. Prefer a quick demo script and 2 example customer personas.

tom_engineering: Ops needs the target region and compute flavor. Also need to confirm image signatures and marketplace packaging format (OCI vs ZIP). Partner said OCI preferred.

nadia_legal: We'll need final quote signoff and partner approval on the joint statement. Also check export controls for partner region (APAC EU special rules). I'll send a short checklist to partner today.

sam_sales: Sales ops request: include pricing metadata in the marketplace listing (MSRP + discount code) and a link to the partner incentive doc. Early adopter slots = 5 customers.

releasebot: scheduled: partnercloud-release-staging -> 2026-05-10T08:30:00Z. Dependents: tagging/partnercloud-ga.

omar_marketing: Content needs: 1) 200-word hero blurb 2) 3 bullets of value props 3) 2 screenshots + alt text 4) datasheet PDF link 5) co-blog draft. Can each owner ack?

cleo_partnerships: I'll consolidate partner assets and confirm the datasheet link. Partner also shared a short partner quote we should embed.

rachel_csm: I'll draft the onboarding runbook and include SSO, provisioning steps, and escalation matrix. Need a sample admin account from engineering.

tom_engineering: Sample admin creds will be ephemeral; I'll create a terraform module snippet. Pasting minimal snippet for marketplace packaging: 
```
# package manifest (example)
name: redwood-partnercloud
version: 1.0.0
asset: quay.io/redwood/partnercloud:1.0.0
```

nadia_legal: Reminder: embargo rules apply. No external posting before 2026-05-12 16:00 UTC or earlier if partner requests. Any press outreach requires approved list.

omar_marketing: We should run a dry-run of the marketplace publish process with the release team on May 8. 20m for publish steps + 25m for blog deployment rehearsal. Can we get attendees?

cleo_partnerships: Partners want to do a short co-hosted webinar the week after launch. Let's align the asset timeline so marketing can promote it.

sam_sales: FYI pipeline note: three prospects already asked about PartnerCloud integration. Need a short FAQ (SSO, data residency, latency). I'll compile and drop it here.

rachel_csm: Also adding a support-level SLO suggestion: initial triage < 4 hours, escalation to eng < 24 hours for P1. Will include in handoff doc.

tom_engineering: Ops note: for the sandbox tenant we recommend using t3.mediumx for demo traffic and a cached model checkpoint to reduce token cost. Will share terraform var defaults shortly.

omar_marketing: I'll own the landing + co-blog. Draft timeline: May 4 internal draft, May 6 partner review, May 9 finalize.

cleo_partnerships: Action owners: @nadia_legal partner sign + embargo checklist, @tom_engineering sandbox + package manifest, @omar_marketing landing + blog, @rachel_csm onboarding runbook, @sam_sales FAQ + incentive link. Confirm?

all: :thumbsup:

releasebot: note: artifact tag release/partnercloud-ga will trigger canary publish to marketplace-staging.

cleo_partnerships: I'll send a short spreadsheet with deliverable owners and deadlines after this thread. Thank you everyone.
